plugin.name: Free Model Gateway
plugin.description: A batteries-included local free-model gateway: ships the server runtime with the plugin, so it runs right after install and syncs its models into the Astravia model list. Compliance risk of the upstream channels is the user's own.
view.label: Free Model Gateway
view.description: Local free-model server and model sync
settings.title: Runtime settings
settings.autoStart: Start the server when the plugin activates
settings.autoStartHint: When off, start it manually from here. The server stops automatically when the plugin is disabled or the app quits.
usage.title: How to use
usage.body: Once ready, the models appear in the Astravia model picker — just select one. Channels that need a login must be signed in from the server management UI (open it in the browser and follow the QR prompt); login-free channels (EAC, Gemini) work immediately after install.
error.serviceFailed: The server failed; check the server log
error.installFailed: Failed to install the server runtime; retry or reinstall the plugin
error.startFailed: Failed to start the server; see the server log for the cause
error.noForwardKey: Could not read the server key (forwardKey); restart the server
error.syncFailed: Model sync failed; check that the server is healthy
error.emptyModels: The server returned an empty model list; existing configuration was kept
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The upstream reuses vendor free inference channels by emulating their IDE clients, which may violate the terms of those services and carries the risk of account or channel restrictions; some channels have quota limits. This plugin is only a management UI for a local server and model sync; it does not provide or endorse any channel. Continuing means you understand and accept these risks.
